Our Service Locations in Orange County, CA Carpet and Duct Cleaning proudly serves all locations throughout Orange County, California. Our professional team provides top-quality carpet cleaning, air duct cleaning, upholstery cleaning, and more across all OC communities. We understand that each location has unique needs, and our certified technicians are trained to deliver exceptional results at every service location we visit. Locations We Serve Our service locations include all major cities and communities in Orange County. We provide expert cleaning services at locations in Irvine, Anaheim, Santa Ana, Huntington Beach, Newport Beach, Costa Mesa, Orange, Fullerton, Garden Grove, Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, Laguna Niguel, Lake Forest, Mission Viejo, Aliso Viejo, Dana Point, San Clemente, San Juan Capistrano, Rancho Santa Margarita, Coto de Caza, Ladera Ranch, and many more. No matter which location in Orange County you're in, our team can reach you quickly. Professional Cleaning at All Our Locations At each of our service locations, we bring the same commitment to quality and customer satisfaction. Our locations are served by experienced, IICRC-certified technicians who use professional-grade equipment and eco-friendly cleaning solutions. Whether you need carpet cleaning at your Irvine location, air duct cleaning at your Anaheim location, or upholstery cleaning at any other location in OC, we deliver results that exceed expectations. Check Your Location Use our ZIP code checker above to see if we service your specific location. We are proud to offer convenient scheduling, competitive pricing, and exceptional service quality at all our Orange County locations. Contact us at (949) 992-3299 to book a service at your location today. Our team is available Sunday through Thursday 24 hours a day and Friday from 8am to 5pm, ready to serve your location whenever you need us. For more information about indoor air quality guidelines and how professional cleaning can benefit your location, visit the EPA website. Trust Carpet and Duct Cleaning to keep all your locations clean, healthy, and well-maintained throughout Orange County.
